<<Stacking Peat For A Stove, Briefly>>

Peat is a natural fuel source that can be stacked for a stove. It’s easy to handle and burns cleanly. Start by gathering dry, crumbly peat. Stack it in layers, about 4-6 inches high. Make sure each layer is evenly spaced. Place the stove on a stable surface and light the peat from the bottom. It will heat up quickly and provide steady warmth. P.P.S. Do not forget the volunteers.
